title.zh: 【萨尔瓦多正与 Modveon 合作开发基于 Base 的官方稳定币支付应用】
title.en: 【萨尔瓦多正与 Modveon 合作开发基于 Base 的官方稳定币支付应用】

current_state.zh: El Salvador, after five years of Bitcoin legal tender and limited everyday payment adoption, is working with Modveon to build an official Base-based stablecoin app that lets citizens hold and send digital dollars, primarily for remittances.
current_state.en: El Salvador, after five years of Bitcoin legal tender and limited everyday payment adoption, is working with Modveon to build an official Base-based stablecoin app that lets citizens hold and send digital dollars, primarily for remittances.
